newsitem.title: FRANCE: Gle Eaux takes ABSat channels on cable TV.
newsitem.headline: Gle Eaux takes ABSat channels on cable TV.

text.p: French digital satellite television service ABSat said on Wednesday it signed an accord with Compagnie Generale des Eaux (CGE) under which nine of its 20 channels would be broadcast on the digital service offered by CGE's cable television unit.

It said in a statement that Compagnie Generale de Videocommunication's (CGV) cable networks would carry from July 1 AB's family channel, two music channels, a sport channel, a tourism and discovery channel, an animal channel, a channel on hunting and fishing, a car channel and a channel covering unusual non-competitive sports and eroticism.
CGV's digital cable television service was launched in December 1996 and counts 25,000 subscribers out of a total 37,000 subscribers to its cable service, the ABSat statement said.
ABSat is a unit of AB Productions.
